title: Open-claim aging report as of a date nobody has given (must go to a person)
businessPurpose: Claims management wants, per customer, how many claims are still open and how many days the oldest and the average open claim have been waiting. The query takes the date to age them to as a bind variable, :AS_OF_DATE. A person must decide that date: it is not in the data (the newest claim is not the reporting date), and the days waiting, the oldest and the average all move with it, so there is no single reference result. A translation cannot be checked without it, and a guessed date would only produce a plausible number nobody asked for. The correct outcome is needs_human_review with the reason bind_parameters, and no model call. expected_result.csv therefore holds only the column names: it is a placeholder, not a reference, and becomes one when someone declares the date under bindValues.
